headline: Fresh Turns Stir the Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the base ledger has shifted in three contested sectors. Linn Mercy now counts seven Colonial, three Warden and one neutral base, against nine, one and one previously; four base events fell in the latest two hours. Callum’s Cape stands at three Colonial, four Warden and no neutral, with two events in that span. Mooring County is ten Warden, two Colonial and no neutral, after its neutral base changed hands; five recent events were logged there. Weathered Expanse keeps the same six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral bases, but records seven events in two hours amid heavy casualty increments. Marban Hollow remains five Colonial, two Warden and one neutral; it was quiet in the latest two hours, though four events mark the past six. Stonecradle’s nine bases remain Colonial-held, with no events in two hours after nine in the day; Godcrofts is wholly Colonial-held and quiet. Lykos Isle has logged a recent Warden capture, leaving six Colonial bases to one Warden. The war remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
